Pick who suggests threads, writes lenses, answers questions and reads unfamiliar files.

Just a host like api.openai.com becomes https://api.openai.com/v1. For anything else, paste the full base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. The key stays in this browser only. It never goes into your saved data or downloads.

This copy of Transactions is running inside claude.ai, where pages can only talk to Claude. To use ChatGPT, open the downloaded transactions.html file in your browser. Your settings here will work there.
